entries.lead: Tuning wizard records layout choices from the selected platform
entries.text: The tuning wizard reads the selected platform's packaged template when it records clustering, distribution and sort choices, instead of always reading the DuckDB template, so Snowflake clustering choices reach table_tunings. Partitioning still comes from the default partitioning profile. A layout choice is recorded only when the platform's tuning capabilities apply it at execution; otherwise (BigQuery partitioning, Redshift distribution and sort keys, BigQuery clustering) the wizard prints a not-enabled warning with the reason and records nothing instead of printing a success line.
